messages:
anya: Design quick-check: run-history diffs for structured outputs feel too dense. when an invocation returns a large JSON the compact diff hides important keys. idea: show a two-line summary with primary keys, and let the diff expander show full structured delta.
marta: agree. i keep opening entries and scanning through big blobs. a summary that surfaces changed top-level keys + truncated values would be perfect.
ryan: UX POV: show a tag cloud of keys changed (max 6) in the collapsed row, and highlight primary semantic keys (like 'choices' or 'results'). make those clickable to jump into the diff pane.
samir: accessibility: the collapsed summary needs an accessible name that describes the changes, e.g., "Run 7: changed keys title, images, metadata" so SR users know what expanded content contains. add aria-controls to the expander.
olivia: microcopy: current run row says "Output" and the expander says "Structured output" elsewhere. propose unified label: "Result" for single-word clarity. also change the action "View JSON" -> "Inspect result".
marta: small keyboard flow issue: when you open a run and tab into the diff view, the first interactive diff node isn't focused; focus remains at the top of the pane. suggest focusing the first changed key when expanded.
ryan: plus add a short animation to orient users but ensure reduced-motion respects OS preference.
samir: for screen readers, announce "Expanded run 7, 5 top-level changes" via aria-live when user expands. and ensure all diff rows are reachable via arrow keys with role="tree" semantics.
olivia: i18n: the summarized key list must be truncation-safe; use ellipses and provide the full list in a tooltip/aria-describedby.
anya: related: function-def editor — overload previews should show sample invocation with the summarized keys so users can see typical output at a glance. small UX win.
marta: also telemetry: track clicks on specific keys in the collapsed tag cloud so product knows which keys are most interesting.
ryan: can we also add a "jump to invocation in editor" from the run row so folks can re-run with the same params? that would speed iteration.
samir: technically simple: wire the run row to open editor with the stored params and focus the first input. i'll prototype the focus management and aria announcements.
olivia: i'll update the microcopy and prepare labels for i18n. i'll also propose renaming "Structured output" -> "Result details" in the UI strings.
devex-bot: created DEVEX-6233 "Run-history: result summarization, accessible diffs, and editor jump" -> https://issues.redwood/DEVEX-6233
anya: thanks team. aiming for a small beta in the playground by next week.
